definitions.explanation: A medical imaging technique using magnetic fields and radio waves to create detailed images of organs and tissues inside the body.

examples.japanese: MRI{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けた。
{脳|のう}のMRIで{異常|いじょう}は{見|み}つからなかった。
examples.english: No abnormalities were found on the brain MRI.

examples.japanese: MRI{装置|そうち}の{中|なか}は{狭|せま}くて{閉所恐怖症|へいしょきょうふしょう}の{人|ひと}には{辛|つら}い。
examples.english: The inside of the MRI machine is narrow and difficult for people with claustrophobia.

notes:
MRI is a common medical diagnostic tool in Japan. Unlike CT scans, MRI uses magnetic fields rather than radiation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- MRI{検査|けんさ}: MRI examination/scan
- MRI{装置|そうち}: MRI machine/equipment
- MRI{画像|がぞう}: MRI image
- {頭部|とうぶ}MRI: head/brain MRI

USAGE:
- MRI scans require removing all metal objects beforehand
- MRI is written in the English alphabet in Japanese text
- The procedure typically takes 20-60 minutes
